tasks.short: Communicate with students by sign language or computer

steps.what: Read each student's alternative communication method in the patient record ({OTHER}).
Draft an unsaved communication setup from that method and stop.
Check the setup against the student's method, then accept it.
Load only the accepted communication setup for the students ({OTHER}).
Communicate with the students in sign language or on that computer.

tasks.design: She reads the student's alternative method in the patient record ({OTHER}). A deterministic step drafts an unsaved communication setup and stops; she checks it against the method, and a separate step loads only the accepted setup onto the communication computer. She still communicates with the students in sign language or on that computer, in the room, and nothing is sent outside.
tasks.previous_blocker: The alternative method and the computer pages sat in the patient record, and she rebuilt the communication setup before each session.
tasks.enabler_now: The patient record already stores the method, the sign system and the computer pages as fields a configured copy can lift.
tasks.still_hard: Communicating in sign language, or changing the next computer page while the student responds, stays in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She sees whether the student understood the last sign or the last page and chooses the next one.
tasks.altitude: The sessions with students stay hers. She accepts the communication setup before it is loaded, and she does not hand over the sign language or the computer conversation.

reach.task: open the patient record before a hearing session that uses a communication computer
reach.learn: which method, sign system and computer pages the setup may copy, and that it must not add a symbol or change the therapy plan

evidence.claim: Communicating with the student stays with her. The only shorter work is copying the recorded method, sign system and computer pages into an unsaved setup, and loading the version she accepted. Model knowledge. No product in this digest sets up sign language or a communication computer.
Health data are a special category, and a data-protection assessment is expected before a new copy of them. Model knowledge.
A decision about care that is made solely by automated means needs a legal basis under article 22.
The patient dossier is kept for twenty years after the last change.
Ambient recording that captures how staff perform needs works-council consent.

assumptions: The patient record ({OTHER}) stores the alternative communication method, the sign system and the computer page names. She reads them in s1. The draft in s2 copies only those fields into an unsaved communication setup and stops. It does not wait for a check of that output. If a field is missing she types it in s3. The setup adds no symbol the record does not list and does not change the therapy plan.

She accepts the setup in s3. s4 loads only that accepted version onto the communication computer ({OTHER}). When the method is sign language, the same step records the sign system for the session. A wording change voids the load.
The session in s5 is not shortened. Talking with the student is in the room. A message to a parent or another school would be its own gated step and is not built.
The 7 already-counted hours are the check in s3 and are not subtracted again. The 2 incremental hours are rebuilds when she rejects a setup.
The communication computer is the student's device. It does not record staff. The load does not decide care on its own. The method she copies is already in the dossier.
unknowns: Whether this patient record stores the method, the sign system and the computer pages as fields, or only in prose.
Whether loading a setup onto a student's communication computer needs fresh consent from the student or a parent.
research_questions: What share of communication setups she rejects because the student's method changed after she read the patient record.

already_counted.description: Checking the setup against the student's method is already in s3.

incremental.description: Rebuilding a rejected communication setup herself, beyond the check already in s3.

approvals.approved_version: Communication setup she accepted in s3: the method, the sign system and the computer pages copied from the patient record she read, with no added symbol and no change to the therapy plan. A wording change voids it. The load uses this version and no other.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a week where the method is prose, she rebuilds the setup and about 2 points remain after the 2 hours of rebuilds. On a week where the patient record names the method and the computer pages, she accepts the draft and about 5 remain. The 2 hours are already off the central 8. Communicating with the students stays hers.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research speech or hearing topics and report findings

steps.what: Read the speech and hearing sources for this research question ({DOCS}).
Direct the speech or hearing study and keep the conduct in the room.
Write the study outcome for those speech or hearing topics ({DOCS}).
Draft an unsaved findings report from the outcome and the sources, then stop.

loop.input: The study outcome she wrote and the speech or hearing source paragraphs she stored.
loop.output: Finding sentences, each tied to the paragraph it cites.
loop.check: A sentence with no citation is dropped. The loop does not judge whether the paragraph supports the sentence.
loop.stop: One pass, then stop. She writes any dropped sentence herself in the check.
loop.why_not_simpler: The sources are free text, so a field copy cannot state a finding.

steps.what: Check each finding against its cited paragraph and the outcome, then accept the report.
File only the accepted findings report for developing procedures ({DOCS}).
Tell colleagues the accepted findings for treatments and technologies, in the room.

tasks.design: She reads the sources in {DOCS}, directs the study, and writes the outcome herself. A bounded loop drafts an unsaved findings report with citations and stops; she checks each finding against the cited paragraph, and a separate step files only the accepted report in {DOCS}. She still briefs colleagues in the room, and the report does not leave the organisation or change a treatment.
tasks.previous_blocker: She wrote the findings by hand from the source texts, and a citation was easy to separate from the paragraph that supported it.
tasks.enabler_now: The sources already sit in {DOCS}, and a bounded loop can draft a finding tied to a paragraph she can check.
tasks.still_hard: Directing the study, and judging whether a paragraph really supports a finding, stay with her.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which result matters for a procedure and which finding the paragraph does not support.
tasks.altitude: The studies stay hers. She accepts the findings report before it is filed, and she does not hand over the conduct of the research or the briefing.

reach.task: read a filed findings report before changing a treatment procedure
reach.learn: that each finding must match the cited paragraph and the outcome note, and that the report itself does not change the treatment

evidence.claim: Directing the study and the briefing stay with her. The only shorter work is an unsaved findings draft that cites paragraphs she already stored, her check of those sentences, and filing the version she accepted. Model knowledge. No product in this digest drafts a speech or hearing research report.

Providers are legally responsible for careful use of generative AI: know whether it is a medical device, assess the risks, train, test, and monitor after updates. The same note names medication errors from a wrong registration.
Medical-device software is listed in Annex I, and AI of that kind which needs a notified body is high-risk.
A decision about care that is made solely by automated means needs a legal basis under article 22.
The patient dossier is kept for twenty years after the last change.
Ambient recording that captures how staff perform needs works-council consent.

assumptions: {DOCS} stores the speech and hearing source texts. She reads them in s1. She directs the study in s2 and writes the outcome note in s3. Those steps are not shortened. The outcome note holds the question, the measures and the result. When they are prose, the loop still reads them. She produced the outcome; the sources were already stored.

The draft in s4 produces the unsaved findings report and stops. It does not wait for a check and it does not file. She accepts the report in s5 only when each finding says what the cited paragraph and the outcome support. s6 files only that accepted version. A wording change voids the filing.

The briefing in s7 is a talk with colleagues inside the organisation and is not shortened. A journal submission or a send to another provider would be its own gated step and is not built. The filed report does not change a procedure, a technology or a treatment.
The 10 already-counted hours are the check in s5 and are not subtracted again. The 4 incremental hours are rewrites when she rejects a finding.

The loop reads stored texts. It does not record staff, register a medication, or decide a diagnosis or a treatment. If the outcome includes a patient's speech measures, those stay in the dossier and the report adds no diagnosis. A research committee is not this task.
unknowns: Whether the source texts are in {DOCS} or only in print.
Whether a research committee must accept the report before it is filed.
Whether the outcome note contains identifiable patient measures.
research_questions: What share of findings she rejects because the cited paragraph does not say what the draft says.

already_counted.description: Checking each finding against the cited paragraph and the outcome is already in s5.

incremental.description: Rewriting rejected findings herself, beyond the check already in s5.

approvals.approved_version: Findings report she accepted in s5: each finding states only what the cited paragraph and her outcome note support, with no new diagnosis and no treatment order. A wording change voids it. The filing uses this version and no other.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When most cited paragraphs do not support the finding, she rewrites them and about 3 points remain after the 4 hours of rewrites. When the paragraphs support the findings, drafting and filing are shorter and about 9 remain. The 4 hours are already off the central 16. Directing the study and the briefing stay hers.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Her week is still the sessions with students and the studies she directs. She accepts the communication setup before it is loaded, and she accepts the findings report before it is filed. She does not hand over the sign language, the computer conversation, or the research.
skills_to_grow: Check a communication setup against the recorded method and reject any symbol the patient record does not list.
Check a findings report against the cited paragraph and reject a finding the paragraph does not support.
role.ambitious_version: The only changes are the communication setup on the student's computer and the findings report in the document store. Each is released only after she accepts that version. The sessions and the studies stay hers.
